subject: Novamed pilot: request for uptime annex + latency SLOs
messages:
From: Sita Rao <sita.rao@novamed.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SLA annex and latency SLOs for pilot

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we move towards the pilot procurement approval I need a formal SLA annex that can be attached to our master services agreement (MSA). Key asks from our compliance and platform teams: 

- Uptime commitment: 99.95% monthly availability for the hosted API endpoint used by the pilot (region: us-west).
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile inference latency for text-generation (seq len ~128) <= 200ms for dedicated capacity; for hosted tier we need the typical distribution / fallbacks documented.
- Credits model: what credit schedule do you propose for availability and latency breaches?
- Evidence: telemetry/uptime reporting cadence, retention window for audit logs (min 12 months), SOC 2 / pen test results.

Can you send a draft annex and the order form language we would need to attach to the SOW? I attached our internal procurement checklist (Novamed_SLA_Request.pdf) for reference.

We need this by next Thursday (2026-09-09) to hit our pilot approvals.

Thanks,
Sita Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager
Novamed Health Systems

[attachment: Novamed_SLA_Request.pdf]
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sita Rao <sita.rao@novamed.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SLA annex and latency SLOs for pilot

Hi Sita — thanks for the clear asks and the checklist. We're happy to draft an SLA annex and the corresponding order form language for the pilot. Next steps from our side: 

1) I'll put together an initial draft annex (availability target, latency SLO table, credit schedule, telemetry/evidence appendix) and share it with you and your legal/procurement team.
2) I'll loop in Engineering/Platform (cc'd Karthik) to confirm the 95th percentile latency target for the dedicated pool under the expected pilot load. If 200ms is tight we will provide a compatible latency tier and fallback options.
3) Ben will propose the order form and pricing for a small dedicated capacity commitment for the pilot.

Preliminary note on credits: for availability below 99.95% we typically propose a graduated credit schedule (0.5% credit for monthly availability 99.90–99.95, 1.5% for 99.50–99.90, etc.). We can map this to your procurement thresholds if you'd prefer a hard cap.

I've attached a working draft (Draft_SLA_Annex_Marissa_v0.1.docx). Please review and flag anything you want changed. I'll schedule a short 30-min alignment call for Monday to walk the technical assumptions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

[attachment: Draft_SLA_Annex_Marissa_v0.1.docx]
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sita Rao <sita.rao@novamed.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SLA annex and latency SLOs for pilot

Sita — looped in the commercial details below. Quick summary:

- Pilot configuration: 2x dedicated GPU nodes reserved for the pilot window (30 days). This gives us predictable throughput and makes the 95th pctl latency target on dedicated capacity much more achievable.
- Pricing: $18k/month for the reserved nodes during pilot (one-time setup fee $2k). If we end up converting to reserved capacity we can roll the pilot fees into a quarterly commit with a discount.
- Order form language: add an "Availability Exhibit" referenced in the SOW that points to the SLA Annex. We will include a DocuSign-ready order form with the exhibit attached.

I'm attaching our suggested order form PDF (OrderForm_Novamed_Proposal.pdf) and have created the HubSpot deal (HS-88421). I also pushed a DocuSign envelope — link below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/novamed/orderform/track/88421
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-88421

If Sita and team are good with the above, I'll put the order form into DocuSign and route to procurement.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

[attachment: OrderForm_Novamed_Proposal.pdf]
From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sita Rao <sita.rao@novamed.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 13:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SLA annex and latency SLOs for pilot

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of items from legal/procurement: 

- Evidence package: we need a short appendix describing the telemetry we will provide for monthly availability and 95th pctl latency (CSV or dashboard export), and the retention period for logs (Novamed requires 12 months). Please state the retention and export format in the annex.
- Audit artifacts: include SOC 2 Type II attestation and the latest penetration test summary (or redacted report). If the SOC 2 is hosted, provide a link or redacted PDF.
- Order form: we prefer the Availability Exhibit to be incorporated by reference in the SOW and not embedded inline. Please include exact clause language for procurement to copy into our redlines ("Availability Exhibit shall be attached to and incorporated into the SOW").
- Execution timeline: can we aim to have the final annex + order form ready for signature by 2026-09-08 to meet Sita's approval window? If any of the evidence items require extra time, flag now.

Action items assigned: 
- Marissa: finalize annex wording and state the telemetry export format (CSV + dashboard link) by EOD Friday.
- Karthik: confirm latency profiling numbers for the dedicated pool under the expected pilot throughput and provide any caveats for cold-starts.
- Ben: push the DocuSign envelope after annex final and set recipient order to procurement -> legal.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Contracts Counsel — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129
